id.description: The internal key: lowercase, underscores, never changed. What every save's roster holds.

name.description: The display name. Variants share it and differ by heading (ruling #141).

cardNumber.description: The public card number shown in archive URLs. Assigned once (the next free number; `npm run newkit` does it), never changed or reused. 999xxx is the sim-placeholder range.

heading.description: The title above the name; what tells one variant from another (ruling #141). No commas (ruling #170).

color.description: The element. Also names the art folder, <color>_<id>.

atk.description: Base ATK. Bands and what a stat silently scales are in docs/design/KIT_DESIGN.md.

hp.description: Base HP, 2900 to 4000 for a playable since ruling #68.

tags.description: Free strings that synergies match on: Human, Female, Khalsa, Male, Giant, Demon. Rendered in brackets.

lore.description: One or two sentences for the archive.

storyOnly.description: An enemy or NPC: out of the practice roster and the archive, reachable at /archive/npc.

unreleased.description: Game-ready, not live: visible under next dev, hidden on the deployed site (ruling #171). Delete the flag to release.

permanentPool.description: In the Permanent banner's evergreen pool. Flipped by hand per character, never automatically.

tier.description: Enemy action economy: an elite always acts three times a turn, even alone (lib/game/actionEconomy.ts).

boss.description: Surfaced in the practice Boss Battle picker.

skillName.description: His name for the skill; from a theme, never from its mechanics (ruling #150).

characterId.description: The owning kit's id, repeated on every card.

type.description: attack | attackDebuff | buff | debuff | heal | stance | ultimate (lib/game/skillTypeStyle.ts); fixes the card's class colour (ruling #133).

statMultiplier.description: The one stat the kit scales off (KIT_DESIGN.md: one scaling stat per kit, heals included).

description.description: Player-facing text in the game's voice, written with the kitwords skill. Placeholders such as [stance.counterDamagePercent] resolve per rank; clauses are split by semicolons (ruling #28).

damageRanked.description: [R1, R2, R3] as a percentage of statMultiplier. [0, 0, 0] on a skill that deals no damage.

damage.description: Flat damage % for an ultimate (no ranks); the ladder is damageByUltLevel.

damageByUltLevel.description: Ultimates only: the damage % at ult levels 1 to 6, authored as an explicit ladder (ruling #92).

mechanics.description: One entry per effect (ruling #28); order is the order they apply.

type.description: One of the engine's mechanic types (types/mechanic.ts). The other fields are per type and stay open: a rank-scaled value is `valueRanked` [R1, R2, R3] (or `durationRanked`, `stacksRanked`); a flat one is `valuePercent` / `duration` / `maxStacks`; `stat` or `stats` names what a buff or debuff moves; `name` labels a stance or a stack; `conditionTags` drives a synergy. Bracketed numbers in his draft are ranked, everything else is flat (KIT_DESIGN.md).

applyTo.description: Who it lands on. Absent means self; ally breadth is oneAlly vs allies; enemy breadth is the `aoe` mechanic.

applyToRanked.description: Per-rank audience, same ladder as valueRanked.

requiresDamage.description: Lands after the hit and only if it connected; a tanked or evaded hit grants nothing.

skills.description: Exactly two skills; both enter the deck as cards.

ultimate.description: The ultimate: no ranks, a six-step damageByUltLevel ladder.

title: Character kit
description: One playable, NPC or boss kit, data/characters/<id>.json. Hand-edited and the source of truth; the catalog rejects a file that fails this shape. Tanveer owns every name, number and mechanic (AGENTS.md). Start a new kit with `npm run newkit -- <id> --name <Name> --color <element>`, which copies data/kit.template.json. Wording: the kitwords skill. Audit: the kitcheck skill. Design rules and stat bands: docs/design/KIT_DESIGN.md.
